summary: Iteration 5 (Price Alerts + Watchlist Sorting + Ticker Speed Control + Daily Digest) fully verified. Backend: 11/11 pytest passing in /app/backend/tests/test_alerts_digest.py — GET /api/alerts requires auth (401); POST /api/alerts with direction='sideways' -> 422; target=0 -> 422; symbol='NOTREAL123' -> 400 with detail 'Could not find ticker NOTREAL123'; happy-path POST /api/alerts {AAPL, target:1, above} returns alerts list containing the new alert with numeric 'price' field; GET verifies persistence; DELETE removes it. Background worker: created AAPL target=1 above as delivered@resend.dev, waited up to 90s, alert became triggered with triggered_at and numeric triggered_price populated. Digest: GET /api/digest/settings returns {enabled,last_sent,send_hour:8,timezone:'America/Toronto'}; PUT enabled:true persists; PUT false persists; GET /api/digest/preview returns arrays for watchlist, near_high, near_low, big_movers, market_near_high; POST /api/digest/send as delivered@resend.dev -> {sent:true, email_id:<str>}; POST as admin (undeliverable domain) returns 502 (not 500) as expected. Frontend E2E on live preview URL: signed-out, ticker-settings-btn opens ticker-settings-popover and ticker-source-watchlist has disabled attribute present. Logged in as admin: ticker-speed-fast sets .animate-marquee animation-duration to 28s, ticker-speed-slow to 90s; setting persists across reload (28s after reload). ticker-source-watchlist / ticker-source-all switch works. /watchlist: digest-card visible with 'Morning digest email' copy, digest-toggle click shows toast 'Daily digest on — arrives weekdays at 8:00 AM ET'. watchlist-sort-select opens with 6 options ('% change · top gainers/losers', 'Closest to 52W high', 'Name A→Z', 'Symbol A→Z', 'Order added'); selecting 'Closest to 52W high' reorders watch-row-* and choice persists after reload. watch-alert-CNQ.TO opens price-alert-dialog; picking alert-direction-below, entering 1 in alert-target-input and clicking alert-save-btn creates an alert-row and, after closing, watch-alert-count-CNQ.TO badge shows '1'. Reopening dialog and clicking alert-delete-<id> removes the row and the badge disappears. Regression: /, /movers, /brokers render with correct title 'STEWART CAP — Investment Tracker' and no error text.

integration_issues.issue: Backend correctly returns 502 but no error toast was observed in the UI after click — the network error path may not surface a user-facing toast. Not blocking (admin domain is intentionally undeliverable), but consider showing an error toast when POST /api/digest/send fails.

issues: Carry-over Radix a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — same warning as previous iterations; add DialogDescription (or VisuallyHidden) to silence.

action_items: (Low) Show an error toast on digest-send-now-btn failure so users see undeliverable/network errors.
(Low, carry-over) Add DialogDescription to PriceAlertDialog and other DialogContents to silence Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: alerts.py uses ObjectId(alert_id) in delete without try/except — a malformed alert_id string will raise bson.errors.InvalidId and bubble as 500 instead of 400/404. Wrap in try/except and return 400 for invalid ObjectId.

alerts.check_price_alerts marks the alert triggered BEFORE attempting to send the email; that's the correct 'one-shot' semantics for undeliverable recipients (won't retry indefinitely), but it means a transient Resend outage silently loses the notification. Consider a separate 'email_sent_at' field so ops can spot deliveries that failed.
run_scheduled_digests loops sequentially — fine at low user counts but consider asyncio.gather with concurrency limit as user base grows.

DigestSettings PUT does not read-modify-write user.digest_last_sent — the returned last_sent uses the stale value from the token's user dict, which is acceptable but the shape is consistent with GET so no functional issue.
alerts_worker sleeps 60s BEFORE first tick — a minor delay on cold start; consider running one tick immediately on startup for faster observed cross detection.
Frontend TickerTape persists tape_speed/tape_source in localStorage as expected (verified 28s survives reload). Watchlist sort choice also persists (watch_sort). Good.
Signed-out ticker-source-watchlist correctly has HTML disabled attribute set (verified via getAttribute('disabled') returned empty string i.e. attribute present).

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 new alerts+digest tests; 24/24 regressions from iter4 still valid)
